## Summary

Describe the user-visible change.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated where appropriate
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes
- [ ] No credentials, production IDs, or customer data are included

## Release note

Use a Conventional Commit title. `fix:` creates a patch release, `feat:` a minor release, and `feat!:` / `BREAKING CHANGE:` a major release.
